content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"P365","reason":"Underwrites specialty commercial property and casualty insurance sold through independent agents and brokers, closely matching the target's core insurance business."},{"label":"P029","reason":"Writes specialty commercial property and casualty coverage for small and mid-sized businesses through agents and brokers, the same core underwriting model."},{"label":"P235","reason":"Underwrites commercial general liability, workers' compensation and commercial auto alongside title and mortgage insurance through agents, overlapping the target's commercial P&C lines."},{"label":"P325","reason":"Sells property and casualty insurance, including commercial multiple peril and specialty commercial lines, through independent agents and brokers."},{"label":"P242","reason":"Underwrites specialty property and casualty risks for businesses through independent agents and wholesale brokers, similar to the target's specialty commercial insurance."},{"label":"P187","reason":"Underwrites commercial property and liability insurance for small businesses and contractors through independent agents, a smaller version of the target's commercial P&C business."},{"label":"P132","reason":"Sells fixed and indexed annuities to individuals for retirement through agents and banks, matching the target's annuity business."},{"label":"P081","reason":"Provides annuities and retirement products to individuals and employers, overlapping the target's retirement annuity business though without commercial P&C lines."}]}
